description: Denizen is a browser-based pixel-art office simulation where each NPC is a live AI agent running real business tasks — email triage, job applications, security monitoring, and PC control. It makes AI agent workflows visible and debuggable. The target audience is engineering teams who need to observe, test, and demo autonomous AI behavior in a way that is intuitive for non-technical stakeholders.

sprint.name: Sprint 4 — Real NPC Task Execution
sprint.goal: Every NPC knows what Denizen is, understands their role in building it, and is actively working on sprint tasks. No more generic busy-work.
